ajja.p: [Ima+jja.(adya-saṃ)] (bya) CL=10 (1) Today. (2) Now.  Ajja(na) [ā+anja+ṇya.(ājya-saṃ)]   Butter. See Ajjhenamaggi-
a: (၁)ယနေ့။(၂)ယခု။ ajja အဇ္ဇ(န) [အာ+အန္ဇ+ဏျ။(အာဇျ-သံ)]  ထောပတ်။ အဇ္ဈေနမဂ္ဂိ-ကြည့်။

C: ajja：adv. [Sk. adya] 今日，現在. -kālaṃ 今朝，今時. -tagge 今日以後，今後.
B:
ajja：ajja（na）
အဇ္ဇ（န）
[ā+anja+ṇya. （ājya-saṃ）]
[အာ+အန္ဇ+ဏျ။ （အာဇျ-သံ）]

ajja：ajja（bya）
အဇ္ဇ（ဗျ）
[ima+jja. （adya-saṃ）]
[ဣမ+ဇ္ဇ။ （အဒျ-သံ）]
P:
Ajja，& Ajjā （adv.） [Vedic adya & adyā，a + dyā，a° being base of demonstr. pron. （see a3） and dyā an old Loc. of dyaus （see diva），thus “on this day”] to-day，now Sn.75，153，158，970，998； Dh.326； J.I，279； III，425 （read bahutaṁ ajjā； not with Kern，Toev. s. v. as “food”）； Pv.I，117 （= idāni PvA.59）； PvA.6，23； Mhvs 15，64. ‹-› Freq. in phrase ajjatagge （= ajjato + agge（?） or ajja-tagge，see agga3） from this day onward，henceforth Vin.I，18； D.I，85； DA.I，235.

--kālaṁ （adv.） this morning J.VI，180； --divasa the present day Mhvs 32，23. （Page 10）
K:
ajja：အဇ္ဇ（ဗျ）
[ဣမ+ဇ္ဇ။ （အဒျ-သံ）]
（၁） ယနေ့။ （၂） ယခု။

ajja：＂အဇ္ဇ（န）
[အာ+အန္ဇ+ဏျ။ （အာဇျ-သံ）]
ထောပတ်။ အဇေ္ဈနမဂ္ဂိ-ကြည့်။
O:
ajja：အဇ္ဇ
ဘူ = လဗ်ဘနေ-ရခြင်း၌။ အဇ္ဇတိ။
စု = ပဋိသဇ္ဇနေ-ပြုပြင်ခြင်း၌။ အဇေ္ဇတိ၊ အဇ္ဇယတိ။
R:
ajja：အဇ္ဇ（အ）
ယနေ့၌။ ယခု။
DOP: 1 ajja ind. [ S. adya], today; now; just now; at the present time ; Abh 1155; Vin I 102, 34 (ajj’ uposatho pannaraso); IV 87, 5 (sannidhikārakaṃ nāma ajja paṭiggahitaṃ aparajju khāditaṃ hoti); 131, 31 (ajja vā hiyyo vā pare vā); D I 108, 2 (ativikālo kho bho ajja samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ); 205, 5 (akālo kho māṇavaka, atthi me ajja bhesajjamattā pītā); II 22, 15 (alaṃ dān’ ajja uyyānabhūmiyā); 134, 10 (ajja kho pan’ Ānanda rattiyā pacchimayāme … tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati); V 23, 24* (pasadaṃ imaṃ khāda mam ajja muñca); 258, 6* (ajj’ eva pabbajissāmi ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve); VI 28, 6* (ajj’ eva kiccaṃ ātappam); 136, 7* (ajja vo pacchimā rattī); Ap 101, 17 (ajj’ eva dāni pabbajjā ajj’ eva upasampadā ajj’ eva parinibbānaṃ); Sp 1265, 14 (ajjato paṭṭhāya mayhaṃ salākabhattaṃ gaṇhathā ti, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce ajja); Vv-a 246, 22 (tvaṃ ajjato paṭṭhāya dvāraṃ rakkhanto nisīda); Mhv 47:28; Sadd 704, 8 (ajjato paṭṭhāya); — °- kāla , m. , this time, today ; Ja VI 180, 3* (~aṃ padaṃ gacchaṃ; 180, 4´ : ahaṃ ~aṃ pāto va padaṃ mahāmaggaṃ gacchanto); Dhp-a I 53, 9 (yāva ~ā); — °- tā , f. , the present time ; S I 83, 29 (~aṃ ca bhikkhave rājā Pasenadikosalo imaṃ rattiṃ dukkhaṃ sessati parājito ti, Ce, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Se ajjeva); Sp 173, 14 foll. (ajjatagge ti ~aṃ ādiṃ katvā … ~an ti ajjabhāvan ti vuttaṃ hoti) = Sv 236, 6 foll. ≠ Spk I 136, 23 foll. ; — °- divasa , m.n. , the present day, today ; Ps III 179, 21 (tato paṭṭhāya yāva ~ā); Mhv 32:23 (kataṃ puññaṃ yāv’ ~ā tayā); — °- ratti , f. , this night; tonight ; Ja III 23, 3 (~iyaṃ paccūsasamaye satthā parinibbāyissati); 506, 6 (anacchariyaṃ ~iṃ haṭabhaṇḍaṃ āharituṃ); Ap 584, 22 (~iṃ mahāvīra pāpuṇissāmi nibbutiṃ); — °- saṭṭhiṃ , ind. , since six days ago, for six days ; S I 170, 20* (~iṃ na dissanti); — °- (s)suve , ind. , today or tomorrow ; Pv 36:5 (~e jīvitassūparodho); Ja III 260, 12* (~e ti puriso sadatthaṃ nāvabujjhati); V 66, 9* (~e ti saṃseyya); — see also ajjatagge, ajjadagge, ajjaṇho.

ajjatagge.cp: adverb. henceforth; from this day forth.

C: ajjatagge：[adv.] henceforth； from this day forth.
R:
ajjatagge：အဇ္ဇတဂေ္ဂ（နိ） （အဇ္ဇ+အဂေ္ဂ）
ယနေ့မှ စ၍။ ယနေ့ကို အစပြု၍။
DOP: ajjatagge ind. [ajjato + agge (agga 1 ), or ajja-t-agge, with -t- as sandhi consonant; cf BHS adyāgre, adyādagre], from this day onward; henceforth ; Vin I 4, 25 (upāsake no bhagavā dhāretu ~e pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate ti) ≠ A I 56, 10 (Mp II 114, 25 : ~e ti ajjataṃ ādiṃ katvā evam ettha attho daṭṭhabbo ajjatan ti ajjabhāvaṃ, ajjadagge ti vā pāṭho, dakāro padasandhikaro, ajja aggaṃ katvā ti attho); Vin I 56, 7 (yā sā bhikkhave mayā tīhi saraṇagamanehi upasampadā anuññātā tā ’haṃ ~e paṭikkhipāmi); M I 380, 17 (~e samma dovārika āvarāmi dvāraṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ nigaṇṭhīnaṃ); A III 392, 19 (esāhaṃ bhante ~e saṅghe dānaṃ dassāmī ti); IV 206, 15 (na dān’ ahaṃ bhikkhave ~e pātimokkhaṃ uddisissāmī ti); Ja VI 344, 18 (ayaṃ ~e mama putto); Mil 88, 4 ; Sp 977, 27 (~e dāni thero mayhaṃ bhāro); Pj II 196, 18 (~e parājito tvaṃ); — see also ajjadagge.
CPD: ajjatagge, v.r. ajjadagge , ind., from now, hence- forth (t: d cf. s. v. kukkuṭa-sampātika, etc. ) ; prob. — *ajjato agge, see anamatagga, mfn., and daharatagge, and cf., otherwise, āyatagga, ettāvatagga, tamatagge; Ctt. take ajjatagge = ajjatā + agge; ajjataṃ ādiṃ katvā (Sp l 173, 14 = Sv l 236, 6 , etc .) and explain -d- in ajjadagge as a sandhi consonant; gramm, regard -t- as a sandhi cons., Kacc-v 35; Sadd lll 56; Pay ad Mogg l 45). — ( a ) in the usual formula upãsakaṃ mam Bhagavā dhāretu ~ pāṇupetaṃ saranagataṃ: Vin lll 6, 12 (Sp see above ) ;' DN l 85, 14 (Sv do. ); MN l 24, 9 (Ps); SN l 70, 13 (Spk); AN l 56, 10 (Mp); Sn 2 p. 16 note 1 (Pj ll 157, 5 ); Ud 49, 29 (Ud-a); simi- larly: ~ maṃ āyasmanto brahmacāriṃ ( etc. ) dhāretha, AN lll 216, 5 —-217, 1 ; ~ maṃ Bhagavā dāsīsamaṃ ... dhāretu, ib. lV 94, 1 ; — ( b ) in other phrases ( with the foll, verb in pres. or fut. ): esâhaṃ ~, AN ll 199, 25 ; lll 392, 19 ; ete mayaṃ ~ upavasissāma, ib. V 86, 12 ; ~ āvarāmi dvāraṃ niganthānaṃ, MN l 380, 17 ( quoted Sp l 173, 6 ; Sv l 235, 81 ; Ps l 136, 27 ; Mp ll 28, 4 ); ~ dãn' āhaṃ uposathaṃ karissāmi, Ud 60, 21 = Vin ll 198, 21 ; cf. Dhp-a l 142, 11 = lll 154, 11 ; tâhaṃ ~ paṭikkhipãmi, Vin l 56, 7 ; ~ maṃ dassa- nāyôpasaṃkama, Th 485 ( here the Ct. gives ajjadagge as first reading, and ajjatagge as pi-pãṭha); ayaṃ ~ mama putto, Ja Vl 344, 18 .
NCP: ind. henceforth; from this day forth.

ajjatana.p: [Ajja+tana] (ti) CL=9 1) Recently happening, Happening just now 2) Will happen today
a: (၁)ယခုကာလ၌ ဖြစ်သော၊ ယခုမှ ဖြစ်သော။(၂)ယနေ့ဖြစ်လတ္တံ့သော။

C: ajjatana：a. [Sk. adyatana] 今日的，現在的.
B:
ajjatana：ajjatana（ti）
အဇ္ဇတန（တိ）
[ajja+tana]
[အဇ္ဇ+တန]
P: Ajjatana，（adj.） [cp. Sk. adyatana] referring to the day，today’s，present，modern （opp. porāṇa） Th.1，552； Dh.227； J.II，409. -- Dat. ajjatanāya for today Vin.I，17； PvA.171 & passim. （Page 10）
K:
ajjatana：＂အဇ္ဇတန（တိ）
[အဇ္ဇ+တန]
（၁） ယခုကာလ၌ ဖြစ်သော၊ ယခုမှ ဖြစ်သော။ （၂） ယနေ့ဖြစ်လတ္တံ့သော။

ajjatana：အဇ္ဇ-တန（တိ）
ယနေ့အဖို့ဖြစ်သော။ ယခုဖြစ်သော။
DOP: ajjatana mf (~ī) n., m. and ~ī, f. [ S. adyatana], 1. ( mfn ) referring or belonging to today; modern; present ; Dhp 227 (porāṇam etaṃ Atula n’ etaṃ ~ām iva; Dhp-a III 328, 13 : idaṃ nindanaṃ pasaṃsanaṃ vā ~aṃ va adhunā uppannaṃ viya na hoti); Th 552 (nāyaṃ ~o dhammo n’ acchero na pi abbhuto); Sp 1304, 4 (yāva ~aṃ kālaṃ kena ānītan ti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ajjatanakālaṃ); — 2. ( m. ) the period of the current day; this day, today ; Vin I 229, 19 (adhivāsetu no bhavaṃ Gotamo ~āya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā ti) = D I 109, 23 ; Vin II 275, 17 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~ā bhikkhunīsaṅghaṃ pavāretvā aparajju bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pavāretun ti, eds so; CPD would read ajj’ attanā); Ja II 409, 7 (tato paṭṭhāya kira yāv’ ~ā); Ps II 213, 29 (idaṃ ~āya idaṃ svātanāya bhavissatī ti nesaṃ na hoti); Dhp-a I 275, 2 (yāv’ ~ā); — 3. ajjatanī, f. , ( gr.t.t. ) the aorist tense ; Sadd 29, 24 (ettha pana ~iyā); 59, 8 foll. (~ī ti ken’ aṭṭhena ~ī, ajja pabhuti atīte kāle bhavā tabbācakabhāvenā ti); 821, 23 (~ī ī uṃ, o ttha …); 830, 23 (kara icc etassa dhātussa kāsādeso hoti vā ~iyaṃ vibhattiyaṃ: akāsi …).
CPD: ajjatana , mfn. [ sa. adyatana], referring to to-day, modern; Mogg-v Vl 5* (~o kālo); Th 552 (dhammo; = adhunâgato, Th-a); n. ~ām iva ( in sandhi for ~aṃ, opp. porāṇaṃ), Dhp 227 (= adhunā uppannaṃ, Ct. ); yãv'ajjatanā ( abl. ) , until to-day, Ja ll 409, 7 ; lll 264, 21 ; f. ~ī ( q. v. ). [ For ajjatana, Vin ll 275, 17 , read ajj'attanā, cf. ib. 275, 4 ,6 attanā pavāretvā; ajjattanā ti ajjatana, Vjb]. — lfc. v. an-° .
NCP: mfn. & masculine (mfn.) referring or belonging to today; modern; present. (m.) the period of the current day; this day, today.

ajjava.p: [Uju+ṇa.(ājava-saṃ)] (ti) CL=7 (1) (a) being righteous,being honest, being upright; Righteousness, honesty, conscientiousness: (b) going straight, going straight without twists or turns (C) The upright path of the mind. (2) righteous, honest, upright, a person who is righteous, honest,upright

DOP: ajjava ājjava m.n. [ from uju; S. ārjava, n. ], straightness, uprightness ; D III 213, 1 (~aṃ ca lajjavaṃ ca; Sv 981, 2 : yo sa ujubhāvo idaṃ ~aṃ nāma); A III 248, 11 (~ena javena maddavena khantiyā soraccena; Mp III 323, 28 : ~enā ti ujubhāvena avaṅkagamanena); Sn 292 (~aṃ maddavaṃ tapaṃ … avaṇṇayuṃ) ≠ Ja III 274, 1*; Dhs p. 7, 29 (~o ca maddavo ca); Dhs 1339 (°-tā ajimhatā avaṅkatā akuṭilatā ayaṃ vuccati ~o); Sadd 807, 17 (ujuno bhāvo ājjavan ti ca idaṃ akkharacintakānaṃ rucivasena vuttaṃ, sogatamatavasena pana ujuno bhāvo ~o ti ākāro rassattaṃ āpajjati so ca saddapulliṅgattaṃ yebhuyyena); — anajjava , m. , lack of uprightness; crookedness ; Vibh 359, 30 (yo ~o ~-tā jimhatā vaṅkatā kuṭilatā, ayaṃ vuccati ~o); Sv 980, 29 (gomuttavaṅkatā candavaṅkatā naṅgalakoṭivaṅkatā ti tayo ~ā).

( a ) ajjavo ca maddavo ca, Dhs p. 7, 29 (As 53, 13 ; quoted Sadd lll 857); Dhs 1339 ( see Vyu 126, 14-15 , but also Mvu l 133, 8-9 ); — ( b ) ajjavañ ca maddavañ ca, khantī ca soraccañ ca, AN l 94, 24 (Mp, Mp-ṭ); Sn 292 ( acc ); Ja lll 274, 1 * ( do.? ); ajjavañ ca lajjavañ ca, khanti ca soraccañ ca, DN lll 213, 1 (Sv) cf. Mhv LXXXlV, 23: addava . . . lajjidhamma [addava blending of ajjava and mad- dava]; instr, ajjavena javena maddavena khan- tiyā soraccena, AN ll 113, 24 = lll 248, 10 (Mp lll 94, 3 ). — lfc. v. an-°. — °-tā, f. id., Dhs 1339. — °-maddava, n.
